episode_summary: In this episode, Sarah Maslowski shares her proven strategies for using YouTube to generate high-quality real estate leads. She emphasizes the importance of a structured lead conversion system, including Zoom consultations and thorough buyer consults, to convert leads into clients. Additionally, she introduces the showing agent model as a scalable solution for handling multiple clients simultaneously, ensuring efficient service delivery.
